title: Coordinate my sessions
subtitle: Work through your coding sessions
description: Hands work to the coding session that already has the folder, carries on one that ended, or starts a new one only when none fits. It boxes long jobs so it hears when they finish, checks the result, and tells you in a line where each piece stands.
asks: Get the changelog updated in my HELIX folder.
Keep my coding sessions moving and tell me when they land.
